## What and why

Describe the problem and the smallest useful change. Link an issue if relevant.

## Checks performed

List tests/builds and their results, or explain what was not run.
For firmware changes, include flash/RAM usage if available. Distinguish simulated
tests from tests on actual hardware; hardware testing is not required to submit.

## Compatibility and safety

Note any effects on fan control, timeouts, calibration, EEPROM, protocol,
configuration, installation or firmware updating. Write "none" when appropriate.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and understand this personal project may receive no response or review, and this PR may be declined.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant tests/documentation, or explained why not.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code and preserved applicable license notices.

Do not include credentials, sensitive logs or private vulnerability details.
